implementation: F-Secure® Kernel Mode Cryptographic Driver™ for Linux
description: The F-Secure Kernel Mode Cryptographic Driver for Linux is a 140-2 Level 1 compliant software module, which resides at the Kernel Mode level of the Linux OS and provides a number of cryptographic services accessible by other kernel drivers through an Application Programming Interface.
